title: How area-based marketing is reimagining CTV | Taptap Digital

facts.fact: According to Statista (a third-party source cited by the vendor), predicted advertising spend is set to exceed $42 billion by 2028.
facts.quote: predicted advertising spend is set to exceed $42 billion by 2028, these can be profitable areas to address. Source: Statista.

facts.fact: A survey by eMarketer (third-party, cited by the vendor) found that top CTV advertising pain points included measurement and attribution, audience targeting, and ad experiences.
facts.quote: in a survey conducted by eMarketer top CTV advertising pain points included measurement and attribution, audience targeting, and ad experiences.

facts.fact: Taptap's CTV offering is part of an omnichannel offering that also includes DOOH, audio, display, mobile and online video.
facts.quote: CTV rounds out Taptap’s omnichannel offering that includes DOOH, audio, display, mobile and online video

facts.fact: Taptap's area-based approach uses a method called georeferencing, which focuses media investment on areas where target customers are highly concentrated rather than targeting individuals.
facts.quote: Media investment is then focused on areas where their target customers are in high concentration rather than the need to target them individually.

facts.fact: Taptap states that advertisers can onboard and georeference custom data such as GRPs or first-party data.
facts.quote: Advertisers can onboard and georeference any custom data like GRPs or first party data for even more granularity and control.

facts.fact: Taptap announced a partnership with Mastercard Data and Insights in support of its CTV launch, giving access to aggregated purchase data across a range of geographic areas.
facts.quote: In support of the CTV launch is a partnership with Mastercard Data and Insights.

facts.fact: According to the vendor, Dyson and Taco Bell are already using Taptap's CTV solution.
facts.quote: Leading brands like Dyson and Taco Bell are already using Taptap’s CTV solution
